You have just started. Your assignment (recorded on the board as #2 for @env):

You are the Environment, Materials & Lighting Author (`env`) for `D:\项目session\blender-supercar` (Blender 5.3.0 at `D:\APPs\steam\steamapps\common\Blender\blender.exe`, pure CPU EEVEE).

OWNERSHIP & STRICT BOUNDARIES:
- You OWN: `pipeline/v5_env.py`, `textures/*` (and `pipeline/gen_textures.py` if you add a reusable texture generator), `LATEST/v5_stage_env.blend`, and `renders_v5/preview/*`.
- DO NOT TOUCH: `pipeline/v5_anim.py`, `pipeline/v5_clay.py`, `pipeline/v5_stills.py`, `pipeline/v5_viewport_fast.py`, `LATEST/v5_stage_anim.blend`, `LATEST/v5_stage_anim_clay.blend`, `renders_v5/clay_frames/`, `pipeline/mux_*.sh`, or `.md`/`.txt` docs.
- Mention discipline: `@name` wakes that agent. Do not CC. Hand off to `@anim` when `LATEST/v5_stage_env.blend` is finalized; tag `@coordinator` only if blocked.

MISSION — Upgrade V5 Track Environment, Car Materials & Golden-Hour Lighting:
1) Read `pipeline/v5_env.py` and `docs/README_V5.md` (especially §9 pitfalls: road specular <= 0.03 to avoid white sun wedge, `light_linking.receiver_collection` on car fill lights so no bright square hits asphalt, decal brightness balance, CPU budget ~2.3s/frame).
2) Check `read_board` for `@verifier`'s Round 1 audit findings before finalizing (you can inspect `v5_env.py` and prototype immediately while `@verifier` runs).
3) Implement high-impact improvements in `pipeline/v5_env.py` (and `textures/`):
   - Outliner & Scene Cleanliness: Ensure ALL assembly Empty parents (`EM_*`) are placed in their matching `V5_04_Stands` / `V5_05_Pit` / `V5_06_Props` collections (none stranded in root `Scene Collection`!), purge unused orphan meshes/materials at save time, and keep total object count lean (<1,050 objects) so CPU render speed stays fast.
   - Track Surface & Corner Realism: Add heavy-braking rubber skidmark/darkening zones on the racing line approaching major braking corners (Village/Loop, Brooklands/Luffield, Stowe, Vale/Club) + subtle off-line rubber marbles/dust variation (`Specular IOR Level` strictly <= 0.03 on all road/line/kerb shaders!). Add DRS zone marker boards (`DRS`) before Hangar Straight & Wellington Straight, and apex bollards / inner sausage kerbs at chicanes/slow corners without intruding onto `racing_xy`!
   - Pit Lane & Trackside Polish: Refine `textures/` (`pit_garage.png`, `ad_boards.png`, `bigscreen.png`) for crisp broadcast-grade F1 graphic fidelity; add pit-wall timing gantry / pit exit light post (`GREEN` LED) on pit wall.
   - Sky Dome & Dusk Lighting: Upgrade `V5_SkyDome` from coarse 7-step vertex banding to smooth continuous multi-band horizon gradient + subtle warm solar azimuth glow aligned with sun direction so low-angle shots have zero polygon/color banding in the sky! Keep shadows crisp and car highlight wrap clean.
   - Car Material & Brake Rotor Readiness: Inspect car meshes imported from `pipeline/v4_stage_rig.blend` — refine body paint clearcoat/metallic sheen, carbon fiber weave roughness contrast on wings/floor/halo, tire sidewall vs tread rubber contrast, and ensure brake rotor/caliper or brake-glow material exists with a clean named emission input (e.g. `MAT_BrakeGlow` or named node) if helpful for `@anim` to keyframe `brake_heat` glow (document exact material/node name in your post to `@anim`!).
4) Run `"D:\APPs\steam\steamapps\common\Blender\blender.exe" -b -P pipeline/v5_env.py` and `pipeline/v5_preview.py` (or a quick preview script writing to `renders_v5/preview/`), inspect the rendered preview JPGs with `read_file` to verify zero visual regressions (no road specular wedge, no ground light pool, smooth sky, clean pit/kerbs/skidmarks).
5) Post a concise summary of changes, object count, build time, and any material/object names `@anim` needs, tagging `@anim`!
